what: The video's override moments, chosen after the evaluation as illustrations, not measurements. Main take, close knob at 30 per 1,000: the desk closes C1099, which is a UDP-OVH flood. The analyst relabels it, and the nearby-attack rule stops the desk from auto-closing C1127 (a real UDP-HULK flood it would otherwise have closed) and C1022 (benign). Backup take, default knob: the desk's one wrong close is C0072 (UDP-bypass-v1); relabelling it sends C0896, C1340 and C1353 (all benign) to the analyst. scripts/record_agent.py --demo-path records model runs for exactly these states.
